Cleanroom air supply- Dry compressed air that is supplied to cleanrooms to maintain low humidity levels.

Instrument air supply-Many instruments in the pharmaceutical industry require dry air to operate properly. Desiccant air dryers are used to dry the compressed air that is supplied to these instruments.
Product packaging-For blowing and vacuum seal pharmaceutical products. This helps prevent moisture from entering the packaging and affecting the quality of the product.
Product storage-Desiccant air dryers are used to dry the compressed air that is used in the storage of pharmaceutical products. This helps prevent moisture.
Compressed air systems- - Coalescing filters remove oil, water, and other contaminants from the compressed air.

Laboratory gas systems-- Laboratories often use specialty gases such as nitrogen, helium, and argon for research and analysis. Coalescing filters remove contaminants from these gases, which can affect the accuracy of experimental results.

Bioreactors and fermentation systems-Bioreactors and fermentation systems are used in the production of vaccines, antibiotics, and other pharmaceutical products. Coalescing filters remove contaminants from the air supply to these systems, which can affect the growth and purity of the microbial cultures.
Liquid filtration systems-Coalescing filters are also used in liquid filtration systems, where they remove emulsified oil and other contaminants from process water and wastewater streams.

Cleanroom air conditioning- Precision air conditioners provide precise temperature and humidity control to ensure that the cleanroom remains within the required temperature and humidity ranges for maintaining the sterile environment.

Laboratory air conditioning-Precision air conditioners maintain a stable environment within the laboratory to ensure that equipment and samples are not affected by temperature and humidity fluctuations.

Server room air conditioning-Pharmaceutical companies rely heavily on data processing and storage, and precision air conditioners are used to maintain the temperature and humidity levels required for optimal server performance and longevity.

Storage facility air conditioning-Pharmaceutical companies rely heavily on data processing and storage, and precision air conditioners are used to maintain the temperature and humidity levels required for optimal server performance and longevity.
Packaging and manufacturing facilities-: Precision air conditioners ensures that the pharmaceutical products are manufactured and packaged under the correct conditions

Nitrogen generators- : used in packaging, dispensing, and purging. Nitrogen generators produce nitrogen gas on-site, eliminating the need for expensive and hazardous nitrogen gas cylinders. It also provides a consistent and reliable source of nitrogen gas, ensuring that pharmaceutical processes are not affected by fluctuations in the gas supply.

Oxygen generators-: Oxygen gas is used in the pharmaceutical industry for a variety of applications, including fermentation, cell culture, and purification. Oxygen generators produce oxygen gas on-site, eliminating the need for expensive and hazardous oxygen gas cylinders.

Blanketing and purging-Both nitrogen and oxygen generators can be used for blanketing and purging applications, where the gas is used to create an inert environment or remove oxygen from a process to prevent oxidation or degradation of pharmaceutical products.

Analytical instruments-Nitrogen gas is used as a carrier gas in gas chromatography (GC) and mass spectrometry (MS) analytical instruments, while oxygen gas is used as a combustion gas for some analytical instruments. Nitrogen and oxygen generators provide a cost-effective and reliable source of these gases, ensuring that analytical instruments operate accurately and consistently

Cryopreservation-Nitrogen gas is used in cryopreservation processes, where samples and cells are frozen and stored at ultra-low temperatures. Nitrogen generators provide a consistent and reliable source of nitrogen gas, which is used to maintain the temperature and pressure in cryopreservation systems.

Drying equipment- Some pharmaceutical processes require the removal of moisture from materials, such as granulation, tablet compression, and capsule filling. Dehumidifiers are used to provide the required dry air for these processes, ensuring that the materials are not affected by excess moisture, which can impact their quality and stability.

Moisture-sensitive manufacturing processes:Any pharmaceutical manufacturing process where it is sensitive to high humidity levels, which can impact their performance and quality. Dehumidifiers are used to remove excess moisture from the air in these processes to ensure that the required humidity levels are maintained.
